title: AskResponse
description: The assistant's answer, and how it was produced. The provenance is not diagnostics: the interface shows it (docs/11), because an assistant that runs on your own device should say so, and an answer the model did not write should not be presented as though it had.

tool_calls.description: Tools the model asked for, in order. Empty when it asked for none.

from_model.description: False when the answer came from the scoring engine instead — because the model was unreachable, asked for nothing, or produced something that failed validation. The answer is still correct; it is just not the model's sentence.

fallback_reason.description: Why the engine answered instead. Null when the model did.

on_device.description: Always true. The model is local by construction (ADR-0004), and the interface states it rather than leaving the user to assume.
